title: The Space Message Member send runs the plan, email switch, cap and meter gates the campaign send runs

source.ref: Space function scan 2026-11-17 (project thread): sendSpaceEmailDraftAsConversations checked only editor rights and Space status

detail: The Message Member composer and the marketing send-to-people panel mail a designed block email through the ticketed conversation system (ADR-822), not the campaign seam. That path checked editor rights and the Space status (LIVE-727) and nothing else: a Space whose plan has no email, a role without email, or a Space with email switched off could send it, with no ceiling on the recipient list and no campaigns-a-month meter. Fix: the same gates the seam runs (spaceFunctionAccess 'email', isSpaceEmailEnabled, the campaign month meter) plus a per-send ceiling of DAILY_SEND_CAP recipients, all before the first conversation opens. Consent stays the 1:1 stack (ADR-821), as ruled. Unit tests cover each refusal.

verify.note: Fails on main: none of the four gates runs before startConversationMessage. Passes once all four do.
